Portland defeats Colorado in close basketball game

Portland secured a 77-74 victory over Colorado in a basketball game. Olvera was a key player for Portland, scoring 22 points. In a separate game, No. 21 BYU defeated Northern Colorado 98-54, with Collin Chandler contributing 20 points for BYU.
